Every correction this paper has made is registered ONLY in its own prose appendix, which is why 27,195 / 20,324 / 93.2 % / 10,332 / '25 EMC-titled' each survived one or more hardening rounds after being corrected somewhere else in the same document -- the exact failure mode the registry exists to catch.
